summary: Network command modules support eq, neq, gt, ge, lt, le and contains conditions in wait_for, retrying (10 times at 1s by default) until the device output meets the condition.
questions: How do I wait until an interface comes up with Ansible?
What operators can I use in wait_for for network commands?
How many times does wait_for retry?

answer_card.title: wait_for conditions in network commands
answer_card.answer_md:
Operators: `eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `ge`, `lt`, `le`, `contains`.
```yaml
- arista.eos.eos_command:
    commands:
      - show interface Ethernet4 | json
    wait_for:
      - "result[0].interfaces.Ethernet4.interfaceStatus eq connected"
```
The command repeats until the condition is true or retries run out (default 10 retries, 1 second apart).
